meta.label: Hotel share of tourist accommodation (2024)
meta.methodNote: Beds in hotels and similar establishments (all star ratings plus residenze turistico alberghiere) as a share of the comune's total registered tourist-accommodation bed capacity, 2024. 0 means every registered bed is non-hotel (campsites, holiday rentals, agritourism, hostels, B&Bs, mountain huts, other); 1 means the comune's entire registered capacity is hotel beds. Answers 'what kind of tourist accommodation exists here', a different question from the total-capacity and beds-per-resident layers' 'how much'. Undefined (excluded, not zeroed) for a comune with zero total beds - there is no capacity to take a share of. One category of the non-hotel residual, 'alloggi in affitto' (holiday rentals), changes definition from 2025 onward to include informal private rentals for the first time (confirmed live in the source file's own footnote) - this metric's 2024 reference year predates that change, so it does not need to account for it, but a future re-run at a later reference year would need to treat 2024-and-earlier and 2025-and-later as two different definitions of 'non-hotel', not one continuous series.
meta.coverageNote: Covers 7899 of Italy's ~7,900 comuni — unlike the seasonality-index/peak-visitor-multiplier layers from the same broader source, this capacity dataset carries no disclosure-confidentiality suppression at all: a comune with zero registered tourist accommodation gets a real row of zeros, not an absent one. A further 386 comuni are excluded because their ISTAT code in this source doesn't match a current comuni.json id — the same old-province-scheme Sardinia towns and pre-merger codes documented on the seasonality layers, plus several more (this file's coverage goes back to 2002, so it carries more stale codes) — excluded rather than guessed at. Hotel share is additionally undefined for 837 comuni with zero total registered beds (0/0 is not a real 0% or 100%).
